question: The RNA-seq section does not name the line and BioSample cultivar is empty. Use B73?

question: Both groups were switched from 4 mM nitrate 3 d before sampling (NL up to 8 mM, ND down to 0.04 mM; the 4 mM NS control was not sequenced). Under the project phase rule this is coded ND = starvation, NL = resupply, time_h 72. Acceptable, or treat this 3-d level treatment as steady?
proposed_answer: Keep starvation/resupply with time_h 72 (N supply changed at time 0 for both groups); the only contrast is ND vs NL at the same time point.
